196139.overview: Cannon Fodder is a Visual Pinball X table based around the Sensible Software game of the same name. It is a mod of the JP Salas table "Papa Smurf".

196169.overview: Criterium 77 is a rare solid-state pinball machine manufactured in 1977 by Taito do Brasil, the Brazilian subsidiary of the Japanese giant Taito.  It is widely understood to be a licensed version or a close adaptation of the Criterium pinball machine produced by the Spanish company Recel.

208972.overview: CastleStorm is one of two original pinball tables in the Iron and Steel pack, released in 2015 as an add-on for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3. This table is a pinball adaptation of Zen Studios' 2013 side-scrolling, physics-based real-time strategy game CastleStorm, in which the heroic knight Sir Gareth defends his medieval kingdom from an onslaught of Vikings, while winning the heart of their princess.

208986.overview:
Captain America is a Marvel pinball table released in 2011 and available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3 as one of three tables in the Marvel Legends pack. Based on the Marvel superhero Captain America, created by Joe Simon and Jack Kirby, this table chronicles Captain America's exploits as a super soldier battling the Axis Powers in the heat of World War II with his Howling Commandos, facing daunting adversaries who are concocting dangerous experiments to threaten the Allies.

The table was released less than a month before the release of Captain America: The First Avenger, but it is not a tie-in to the film; instead, the table's storyline and plot are heavily based on Ed Brubaker's 65th anniversary Captain America comic.

208989.overview: Civil War (or Marvel: Civil War) is one of the three Marvel pinball tables that are part of the Heavy Hitters pack in Pinball FX 3, originally released in 2012 for Zen Pinball 2 and Pinball FX 2 as a standalone table. The table is based on the 2006-2007 crossover comic book of the same title, in which the high collateral damage from a battle between superheroes and supervillains sparks calls for government control of superheroes. This carries divisive moral implications, resulting in infighting among superheroes disagreeing over whether it should be implemented.

421305.overview:
The show must go on! Clowns, acrobats and high-wire tricks fill this big-top-inspired table with spectacle and surprises.

Circus is an electro-mechanical table with eye-catching colours released by Zaccaria in April 1977, that flows more like an early solid state pinball table.

460227.overview:
Cavaleiro Negro (1981) is a historic pinball machine manufactured by Taito do Brasil, the Brazilian subsidiary of the Japanese giant Taito. It is an adaptation of Williams' legendary Black Knight, featuring the same iconic gameplay elements tailored for the Brazilian market. 

The machine is celebrated as an icon of 1980s Brazilian pinball due to several "firsts" in the region: 

• Multilevel Playfield: It was one of the first machines in Brazil to feature two distinct levels of play, a revolutionary design at the time.

• Early Speech: It was among the first machines in the country to feature digital voice synthesis, famously challenging players with: "Eu sou o Cavaleiro Negro a procura de um desafio" (I am the Black Knight looking for a challenge).

• Magna-Save: Like its Williams counterpart, it included the "Magna-Save" magnets near the outlanes, allowing players to activate a magnet to catch a draining ball.

Despite the massive success of the original Black Knight in the United States, Cavaleiro Negro faced mixed commercial results in Brazil. While it is now a highly sought-after collector's item and a staple at events like the Pinball Clube, it was initially considered a sales failure for Taito do Brasil because it didn't meet the high demand they anticipated.

460228.overview:
Columbia, produced by the Brazilian manufacturer LTD do Brasil, is primarily known as a clone of Stern’s 1980 classic, Flight 2000.

It features a signature ball-locking mechanism—often a "lift" or vertical ball lock—inherited from the Flight 2000 layout. The playfield and backglass art were adapted by LTD to fit the Brazilian market, though they maintained the core space-exploration theme of the original.

Records vary regarding its release date, with Pinside listing it as 1981, while digital restoration communities often cite 1983.

460229.overview: Cosmic is a space-themed pinball machine manufactured by Taito do Brasil in December 1980. Like many Taito do Brasil tables of that era, it is a localized adaptation of an American design—specifically, it is based on Stern's Galaxy (1980).

460231.overview: "Cowboy Eight Ball 2" is a solid-state pinball machine from 1981 manufactured by LTD do Brasil. It is a minor upgrade of "Cowboy Eight Ball", with support for four players added, and updated software.

461843.overview: In Brazil, carnaval represents celebration, collective joy, and cultural expression rooted in music, movement, and community. This carnaval themed, electro-mechanical table was released by LTD do Brasil twice, first in 1977, and then later in 1981. The only difference between the two releases is a slight change to the backdrop.

463979.overview:
The Cine Star (also referred to as Cinestar) is an electro-mechanical (EM) pinball table with a classic cinema/film industry theme.

Produced by the Italian manufacturer Zaccaria in 1974 with art designed by Lorenzo Rimondini, the table is described by enthusiasts as a "Boardwalk-style" pin, featuring a tight playfield that encourages chaotic, noisy ball movement. 

It is known primarily for a central gimmick - a large spinner sometimes nicknamed the "Quacker" because Zaccaria recycled duck-themed parts from older Gottlieb machines. Each spin scores between 10,000 and 100,000 points. 

The playfield also features twelve star-lights. If a player manages to light all twelve, a "Special" is activated, which can grant an extra ball if hit shortly after a successful spinner shot.

The physical machine originally used a five-digit score display, but it featured backlit "millions" and "hundreds of thousands" indicators on the backglass to track scores up to 9,999,990.

The table is known for a high "suicide" rate, with roughly one-third of balls plunging directly into outlanes or down the drain shortly after the serve.

468508.overview: Champions is one of the two Marvel pinball tables that are part of the Women of Power pack, released in the fall of 2016 and available for Zen Pinball 2, Pinball FX 2 and Pinball FX 3. It is based on the female members of the 2016 superhero team known as the Champions, and follows an original story in which Ms. Marvel, leader of the Champions, must defeat the Bombshells and save the world while thwarting their theft of her first day of work's paycheck.

468560.overview: Curse of the Mummy is one of the three Zen Originals that released with the launch of the Pinball FX reboot in March 2022. The table places players in the role of a female archeologist who uncovers the terrifying secret of an ancient Egyptian sanctuary.

468649.overview:
Challenge your skills in this pinball and rhythm fusion table, which captures the wacky atmosphere and killer soundtrack of the acclaimed rogue-like. Stop the NecroDancer once more, as you use your flippers to battle bosses and acquire the Golden Lute.

- Zone in on the zones and boss around the bosses to advance and collect points
- Battle Coral Riff, King Conga and more legendary bosses to earn diamonds
- Follow the flow of music with your combos and boost your multiplier
- Freddie has what you need! Spend your diamonds for weapons and hearts
- Face the NecroDancer in a multiball Wizard Mode for the Golden Lute

469302.overview:
Modern battlefield redefined! Explosions, warships, and precise tactical shots come together with stunning visual effects for an intense pinball experience.

Combat Deluxe is a modern, digital-only reimagining of the original 1977 Zaccaria electromechanical table. 

It transitions the classic war-themed layout into a contemporary experience by adding animated elements, complex layers, and a modern scoring system. It is generally regarded as one of the best "Deluxe" tables available for Zaccaria Pinball.

• Expanded Playfield: Unlike the single-level original, Combat Deluxe features 4 distinct playfields and a total of 9 flippers.

• Modern Display & Audio: The table replaces traditional reels with a fully animated color LCD display (DMD) and features a high-energy "insanely catchy" 80s synth-pop soundtrack.

• Modern Rule Sets: It introduces contemporary pinball mechanics such as multiball, ball saves, and specific mission-based modes that were not possible with original EM technology.

469412.overview:
Tee off in the city! Urban landscapes, slick shots, and golf-themed challenges make this a hole-in-one pinball experience.

City Golf is a digital pinball table first released as part of A.S.K. Homework's "Age of Pinballs Pro" iOS game in 2013. The developer later ported the table to Zaccaria Pinball as an 'award' table in 2025.

469554.overview:
After you play, you’ll wish Chucky’s Killer Pinball was only make-believe! Step into a twisted realm where the innocent becomes sinister, and the playful turns menacing. Navigate through an eerie playfield where Chucky lurks in the shadows, ready to pounce.

- A rollercoaster ramp that you should think twice about before shooting.
- Silver ball bloodbath on multiple parts of the playfield.
- A slashed doll face whose blood-chilling eyes follow the ball.
- The Razor flipper and axe spinner increase the horror awaiting you.
- Epic voiceovers from Chucky, who will unleash havoc on you till your last flip.
- Cut Chucky into pieces before he can finish you with his axe in Wizard Mode.

Okay sport, are you ready to play a game of “Chucky Says”?!

469556.overview: Welcome to Camp Bloodbrook where campfire stories become a reality. Use every ounce of your pinball skills to escape the grip of Jacob Wells, The ‘Wellbound’. A slasher classic swooping you back to the 80s.

469812.overview:
Cuphead Pro is a highly-regarded original pinball table created for the Visual Pinball X platform by developers Onevox, Scottacus, and Bord. Released in 2020, it serves as a stylized tribute to the hit video game Cuphead by StudioMDHR, capturing the aesthetic of 1930s animation and the challenging spirit of classic electro-mechanical pinball design.

The "Perdition Edition" introduces several significant gameplay updates and refinements over the original "Pro" version, including a new 2-ball multiball mode.

470424.overview:
The circus returns in style! Enhanced detail and livelier tricks make this big-top favourite shine brighter than ever.

Circus 2017 is an enhanced digital remake by Magic Pixel of the 1977 electromechanical Zaccaria table, released as DLC in 2017 for Zaccaria Pinball on all major platforms.

470852.overview:
The Clash were an English rock band formed in London in 1976. Billed as "The Only Band That Matters", they are considered one of the most influential acts in the original wave of British punk rock, with their music fusing elements of reggae, dub, funk, ska and rockabilly.

This is a homebrew table first released in 2018 for Visual Pinball X, based on Gottlieb's 1986 "Rock Encore". A heavily updated version of "The Clash" was released in 2021 titled "Clash Pro, Audio Amunition".

471255.overview:
Released by Game Plan Inc. in 1978, Chuck-A-Luck is a cocktail-style pinball machine featuring a distinctive roulette wheel at the center of its playfield. Designed by Ed Cebula with artwork by Paul Loreli, the game includes two flippers, two pop bumpers, and two spinning targets.

Chuck-A-Luck was originally developed under the name "Real", themed after the Real cigarette brand. After poor test marketing results, the licensing deal was cancelled. Game Plan recycled the hardware and playfields for Chuck-A-Luck by using factory-applied stickers to cover the original "Real" cigarette-themed artwork, adding a "Chuck-A-Luck" flag and removing cigarette imagery from the design.

471648.overview:
Released in May 1978, Camel Lights is a solid-state cocktail-style pinball machine manufactured by Game Plan, Inc.. Unlike standard upright machines, it features a horizontal cabinet meant to be sat around like a table. The table is equipped with 2 flippers, 2 pop bumpers, and spinners. Notably, it lacks ramps, multiball, or drop targets.

Camel Lights was part of Game Plan's "Model 110" series. This model featured a unique interchangeable playfield strategy: the same base cabinet and electronic layout were sold under several different themes to save on production costs, especially when specific themes didn't meet sales expectations.

Other machines that shared this exact playfield layout included Rio, Black Velvet, Real, Foxy Lady, and Chuck-A-Luck. Because it was produced for a specific cigarette brand theme, it is considered a rare find for collectors today.

472028.overview:
Step into a chaotic circus where clowns rule and madness reigns! Juggle Multiballs, dive into the funhouse, and trigger wild surprises with every flip. The spotlights on you, can you handle the mayhem?

This table is a modernized version of the original Clown table from 1985 and features a colorful clown theme packed with chaotic fun and whimsical surprises.

Light up the stage as you complete C-L-O-W-N letter modes and master four zany mini games: Dance, Present, Hat, and Juggler. With rules like ball save, combo, kickback, multiplier, multiball, and skillshot, Clown Deluxe brings classic
amusement park energy into the digital era. 

Inspired by the quirky charm of '80s pinball, this table combines nostalgic gameplay with modern twists for a funhouse
experience like no other.

472161.overview:
What's the matter? Don't you like Clowns?

Captain Spaulding is a fictional character created by Rob Zombie. The character first appeared in Zombie's 2003 horror film House of 1000 Corpses, portrayed by Sid Haig. Haig reprised his role as Spaulding in the sequels The Devil's Rejects (2005) and 3 from Hell (2019). The character, and Haig himself, have been called icons of modern horror cinema. Sid Haig passed away in 2019.

Captain Spaulding's Museum Of Monsters and Madmen is an original table for Visual Pinball X and a tribute to Haig, released by Zandy's Arcade in 2025. The game contains adult language and themes.

472354.overview:
As part of a deal with Bally, FarSight Studios licensed the 1994 table World Cup Soccer for inclusion in their Pinball Arcade game. However, FIFA were in an exclusive deal with EA regarding using World Cup branding in a video game. Consequently, FarSight had to change the name of the table to World Champion Soccer, and make a number of changes to the table artwork so it could be included in Pinball Arcade.

This digital table has many changes; the W-O-R-L-D-C-U-P lights leading to the left loop are replaced by C-H-A-M-P-I-O-N, World Cup USA 94 on the plastics between left in-lanes and out-lanes are renamed to Champion Soccer TPA 17. The backglass was also changed to avoid possible lawsuits from FIFA for using the tournament's mascot Striker, World Cup USA 94 name and any other references to World Cup USA 1994 without the required license.

473885.overview: Centaur: ULTIMATE Edition is a mod of Bally’s ⁠classic 1981 motorcycle and Greek mythology-themed pinball machine. SLAMT1LT has leant into the heavy metal aspect of the table's original artwork, and added 12 different Iron Maiden songs that can be selected to accompany gameplay.

474184.overview:
Centigrade 37 is an electro-mechanical pinball machine manufactured by D. Gottlieb & Co. in August 1977, The game revolves around a distinctive sci-fi medical premise: players must revitalize a cryonically suspended woman. To do this, you must raise her body temperature back to a normal human level of 37 degrees Centigrade (indicated as 98.6 degrees Fahrenheit on the backglass).

SLAMT1LTS ULTRA Edition for Future Pinball adds music and sound effect. A subsequent mod by NitroNimbus adds a DMD, improves the lighting, and switches out SLAMt1LT's music for "Ring Of Fire" by Johnny Cash.

480131.overview: Released as a follow-up to Ivan TBA's earlier table, Pepsiman (2019), Cherry Coke is a mod of Skateboard (Inder, 1980) for Visual Pinball X.

480700.overview: An original electromechanical-style table for Visual Pinball 9 based around the Cartoon Network and its classic 90s cartoon series.

480704.overview: Contra is a tribute to Konami's classic NES game, released for Future Pinball in 2014.
